A food item which restores energy and applies the deep sleep buff when consumed . It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, vegetable soup will apply the deep sleep buff for a duration of 2 minutes. Allowing the player to regenerate more energy points during sleep.
